newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF says to decide Nomura penalty schedule soon.
newsitem.headline: MOF says to decide Nomura penalty schedule soon.

text.p: Japan's Ministry of Finance will decide within a few days on the schedule for imposing penalties on Nomura Securities Co, based on recommendations submitted to it on Tuesday by the Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told a news conference on Wednesday.
Asked about the schedule for hearings from Nomura officials and the imposition of administrative penalties, Mitsuzuka said: "We would like to decide on the schedule either today or tomorrow."
He added that the ministry was preparing for the hearings with Nomura officials.
